clue.text: Damage advanced autonomous program hosted by wise person

indicators.note: being hosted by something means sitting inside it, so the wise person's letters hold the other pieces

parts.note: a sage is a wise person
A is a standard abbreviation for advanced, as in A level
a bot is a program that runs on its own

explanation.surface: Some rogue software, housed by a guru, is causing damage.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberate wrecking of machinery or plans is the core sense of the word, so it works as a noun synonym for damage.

clue.text: Recording device always involved in R&B

indicators.note: to be involved in something is to be wrapped up within it, so one word's letters sit inside the other's

parts.note: R&B is rhythm and blues; its letters R and B are used as given
ever is an old synonym of always, as in 'ever yours'

explanation.surface: A piece of studio kit is always used on rhythm and blues tracks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved in' places EVER between the R and B of R&B.
explanation.definitionFit: An echo effect unit is a standard piece of studio gear used when recording music, so it counts as a recording device.

definitions.meaning: set aside or held back for someone, as a booked table is

explanation.surface: Someone held themselves apart from others.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a booked seat is held for someone, and a shy, reticent person is described the same way.

indicators.note: in a down clue an overturned word is turned upside down, so its letters read from the bottom up

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A car flipped over by a European in a motor contest.
explanation.definitionFit: A contest of speed is a competition, the plain synonym here.

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to pass judgement on a convicted person
a complete unit of words with subject and verb

explanation.surface: A grammarian denounces the way a phrase is built.
explanation.definitionFit: A judge passes this on a criminal, and a full stop ends one, so the verb and the noun each fit.

indicators.note: one piece getting in another means it goes inside it

parts.note: RD is the abbreviation for road, a way
an aide is an assistant

explanation.surface: A helper was fired for obstructing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sacked' looks like fired, but here it means plundered, as when a town is sacked.
explanation.definitionFit: To sack a town is to plunder it, so sacked and plundered by attackers are past-tense synonyms.

indicators.note: a development is a working out into new form, so the letters of the word tech are rearranged

explanation.surface: Funding for tech development is slashed.
explanation.definitionFit: To engrave by incising lines into a surface is a way of cutting it.

clue.text: Arrived with artist and photographic equipment

parts.note: came means arrived
RA is a Royal Academician, the crossword artist

explanation.surface: A painter turned up with gear for taking pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: The device that takes photographs is the basic piece of photographic kit.

clue.text: Persuade prisoner with bad habit to inhale nitrogen

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner

parts.note: a vice is a bad habit
N is the chemical symbol for nitrogen

explanation.surface: A jailbird with a nasty vice is talked into breathing in gas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to inhale' puts N inside VICE, making VINCE.
explanation.definitionFit: To win someone over by argument is to persuade them; the two verbs are synonyms.

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm
PE is physical education, a school exercise lesson

explanation.surface: Running a business that teaches fitness classes.
explanation.definitionFit: To get by or handle a situation is to manage, the intransitive synonym.

indicators.note: the answer reads the same back and forth, so it is its own reversal

clue.text: Ban writer with article in Watchtower

an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A writer and an article are banned from a lookout post.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified outer tower over a castle gate or wall served as a lookout post, hence a watchtower.

clue.text: Clubs in the middle covering old card

median means situated in the middle

explanation.surface: A club suit card in the middle of the pack lies on top of an old card.
explanation.walkthrough: 'card' is the slang for a joker or funny person, not a playing card.
explanation.definitionFit: A card is old slang for an amusing, eccentric person, and a professional joker is such a figure.

definitions.meaning: to cut short, as with a tail or wages
a place for ships to tie up and load

explanation.surface: A port cuts back its operations.

clue.text: Ponder projection on front of innovative gallery

parts.note: a cog is a tooth projecting from a gear wheel

indicators.note: the front of a word is its first letter, here of innovative

parts.note: the Tate is a London art gallery

explanation.surface: Mulling over a projected image on the front of a modern art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: The Tate is a group of art galleries in Britain, the best known in London.
explanation.definitionFit: To think deeply or mull over is to ponder; the two verbs are synonyms.

indicators.note: the answer reads the same back and forth, so it is its own reversal

parts.note: PA is per annum, Latin for yearly
rent is what you pay for housing

indicators.note: the end of a word is its last letter, here of fingers

explanation.definitionFit: Plural nouns for occasions when people come together, as in chance meetings or encounters.

clue.text: Popular old lady with note for convict

ma is informal for mother, one's old lady

clue.text: Dread ragweed appearing at regular intervals

indicators.note: every second letter of the word ragweed is taken

explanation.surface: Fear of a weed that crops up again and again.

clue.text: Publication by head of irreligious priests

parts.note: a mag is a magazine, a publication

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter, here of irreligious

explanation.surface: A magazine run by an unbelieving editor about clergy.
explanation.definitionFit: The wise men of the Nativity were Zoroastrian priests, the plural of magus.

indicators.note: radio is heard, not seen, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a flea is a bloodsucking parasite

explanation.surface: A bug gets away while the wireless is playing.

parts.note: might means power or strength

parts.note: a lair is a wild animal's den

explanation.definitionFit: A being is any thing with distinct existence, the noun sense of the word.

clue.text: Length of one street in Charleston perhaps

indicators.note: in means placed inside the other piece

parts.note: the Charleston is a 1920s dance, an example
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: How long one road in a South Carolina city is.
explanation.walkthrough: Charleston looks like the American city but is the 1920s dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Distance is a measured length between points, a close synonym.
